rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer tooling and DX from Anthropic, Vercel, and Bun—exactly the infrastructure layer Jake believes creates unfair advantages for founders. Jake's conviction around B2A systems and low-level AI infrastructure aligns with Lydia's current work on agentic coding tools (Claude Code), and her ability to translate complex technical concepts into visual, accessible content could help him articulate the emerging B2A category to both builders and investors.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Jake Fitzgerald — you're both betting on developer tools and AI infrastructure as the next wave, and Lydia's track record translating cutting-edge tooling into developer adoption could be valuable as Jake scales Derive Labs' vision.
